MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The waterproof Gorilla tape feels like a natural choice because I have bought Gorilla tape more than once, and it offers a useful option for repairs exposed to moisture.",
    "The assorted heat shrink terminals closely match the connector types and wire sizes I bought before. The separate heat shrink tubing also makes sense as insulation for those wiring repairs."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The nuts and screws are repair supplies, but I would need to know the exact fastener a project requires before choosing either assortment or a hundred identical screws.",
    "Vinyl cement and tape serve different purposes from rigid epoxy or super glue, so my adhesive purchases do not make those automatic next choices, especially ten tubes of glue.",
    "The drill brushes address a cleaning task I have not shown a need for, while two cans of WD-40 would require a clearer maintenance need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying practical repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any hardware or maintenance product, even when its specific purpose does not match my purchases.",
    "My repeated Gorilla tape purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in other Gorilla adhesives and large packs, although the shared brand alone is not enough for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The specific terminal shapes and wire sizes in my previous connector assortment matter: a varied compatible kit is more useful to me than a kit limited to wire splices.",
    "I choose supplies for particular repair tasks. Material compatibility, insulation, and moisture protection matter more than simply belonging among tools and repair products.",
    "Pack size needs to fit the task; a previous bulk tape purchase does not mean I want large quantities of every repair supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in tape and wiring repairs, but extended it too broadly to hardware, adhesives, and maintenance supplies without a clear matching task."
}
